title: Create a cross protocol filter, 3gpp.tmsi
description:
It can be useful to track a "call" trough multiple protocols to make
that easier create a cross protocol filter, more may come.

notes.body:
I guess the filter should be added to packet-gsm_a_gm.c also.

I'm wondering if mixing TMSI/P-TMSI/M-TMSI in a single filter is a good thing or not, but I find equal arguments in favor and against.

Presumably you want to include the 5G-TMSI in the filter also (so packet-ngap.c and packet-nas_5gs.c).

Hi,
I'll go with the ones in the patch for now and add more if requested.
